description: This Go source file defines data structures and functions for parsing and summarizing network socket information from /proc/net/{udp,udp6,tcp,tcp6} files in Linux, specifically for Prometheus's procfs package.

methods.name: newNetIPSocket
methods.description: Reads a specified /proc/net/* file and parses its socket entries into a slice of netIPSocketLine structs.

methods.name: newNetIPSocketSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of socket data (total queue lengths, used sockets, drops) from a specified /proc/net/* file.

methods.name: parseIP
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal IP address string into a net.IP object, handling both IPv4 and IPv6 formats.

methods.name: parseNetIPSocketLine
methods.description: Parses a line of socket data fields into a netIPSocketLine struct, extracting addresses, ports, state, queues, UID, inode, and drops.
